description: Evals for gdpr-review — verifies triggering accuracy and functional behavior across review modes (triage, deep, verify)

evals.description: Direct trigger using the canonical command phrase

evals.prompt: Run an RGPD review on the user registration spec
Check the privacy compliance of our notification feature
evals.description: Trigger via intent — user wants privacy review without using 'GDPR' explicitly

evals.prompt: Data protection check on the analytics brief
Check accessibility compliance of the dashboard
AI Act compliance review on the recommendation engine
GDPR review on the user registration brief at docs/features/user-registration/BRIEF.md
evals.description: Given a BRIEF that mentions user accounts and email, does the agent run triage mode and detect personal data?
expected_behavior: Detects BRIEF artifact type and enters Triage mode
Identifies personal data elements (email, name, password)
Classifies data categories
Produces Initial Risk Assessment
Produces Recommendations for SPEC
Includes legal disclaimer
Passes validate-gdpr-review.sh

evals.prompt: Run a GDPR review on the analytics dashboard spec at docs/features/analytics-dashboard/SPEC.md
evals.description: Given a SPEC with tracking and user behavior data, does the agent run deep mode with full data inventory and legal basis assessment?
expected_behavior: Detects SPEC artifact type and enters Deep mode
Builds Personal Data Inventory table
Assesses legal basis for each processing activity
Checks data subject rights coverage
Assesses privacy by design
Evaluates DPIA triggers
Produces compliance acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then format
Cites GDPR articles

evals.prompt: Check GDPR compliance of the notification system plan at docs/features/notification-system/PLAN.md
evals.description: Given a PLAN and a prior GDPR-REVIEW.md, does the agent run verify mode and produce a gap report?
expected_behavior: Detects PLAN artifact type and enters Verify mode
Loads prior GDPR-REVIEW.md
Cross-references GDPR requirements against plan steps
Produces Coverage Check table
Produces Gap Report with severity levels
Does not re-run full deep analysis

evals.prompt: GDPR review on the authentication spec at docs/features/auth-system/SPEC.md
evals.description: Does the agent confirm each section with the user before moving on?
expected_behavior: Proposes Data Inventory and waits for confirmation
Proposes Legal Basis Assessment and waits for confirmation
Proposes Data Subject Rights Coverage and waits for confirmation
Does NOT output the full review without intermediate confirmations

evals.prompt: Fais une revue RGPD sur le brief d'inscription utilisateur
evals.description: If the conversation is in French, is the GDPR-REVIEW.md still written in English?
expected_behavior: Responds to the user (may use French for conversation)
Writes GDPR-REVIEW.md content entirely in English
Section headers, findings, recommendations — all in English
